From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@novapulse.com>, Tom Baker <tbaker@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: 30-min preview: confirm a slot + SME nomination

Hi Samantha (and Tom),

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and helpful context on where Novapulse is heading with search & routing. Quick recap and proposed next step: a 30-minute product preview focused on the integration points we discussed (ingest, embeddings, and latency expectations).

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Option A: Thu May 7, 10:00–10:30 AM PT (convert: 1:00–1:30 PM ET)
- Option B: Fri May 8, 2:30–3:00 PM PT (5:30–6:00 PM ET)
- Option C: Mon May 11, 9:00–9:30 AM PT (12:00–12:30 PM ET)

Please pick the best window for your team and nominate the SME(s) who should join (engineering or data lead preferred). If none of these work, tell me two 30-minute bands that do and we’ll recycle a slot.

A couple of quick asks before the call so we can tailor the demo:
- Confirm the dataset size (approx. rows/documents) and expected query concurrency.
- Any compliance or data residency concerns to flag in the run-through.

I’ve attached my post-discovery notes so you can confirm I captured the priorities correctly.

Next steps once you pick a time: I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and the short demo deck.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Option B (Fri May 8, 2:30 PM PT) works best for us. I’m looped in with Tom (cc’d) who will be our engineering SME. Tom — are you able to join that time?

Quick answers to the prep asks:
- Dataset: ~12M documents (mostly text, mix of metadata)
- Concurrency: peak ~80 QPS, but typically 10–20 QPS

If you can share a short agenda and the deck ahead of time, I’ll circulate to the stakeholders. Also please send a calendar invite.

Best,
